sn42.7:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā nāḷandāyaṃ viharati pāvārikambavane.
sn42.7:1.2: atha kho asibandhakaputto gāmaṇī yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho asibandhakaputto gāmaṇī bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn42.7:1.5: atha kiñcarahi bhante bhagavā ekaccānaṃ sakkaccaṃ dhammaṃ deseti ekaccānaṃ no tathā sakkaccaṃ dhammaṃ desetīti.
sn42.7:1.6: tenahi gāmaṇi taññevettha paṭipucchissāmi. yathā te khameyya tathā naṃ byākareyyāsi.
sn42.7:1.7: taṃ kiṃ maññasi gāmaṇi idha kassakassa gahapatino tīṇi khettāni ekaṃ khettaṃ aggaṃ ekaṃ khettaṃ majjhimaṃ ekaṃ khettaṃ hīnaṃ jaṅgalaṃ osaraṃ pāpabhūmi.
sn42.7:1.8: taṃ kiṃ maññasi gāmaṇi asu kassako gahapati vījāni patiṭṭhapetukāmo kattha paṭhamaṃ patiṭṭhapeyya yaṃ vā aduṃ khettaṃ aggaṃ yaṃ vā aduṃ khettaṃ majjhimaṃ yaṃ vā aduṃ khettaṃ hīnaṃ jaṅgalaṃ osaraṃ pāpabhūminti.
sn42.7:1.9: asu bhante kassako gahapati bījāni patiṭṭhapetukāmo yaṃ aduṃ khettaṃ aggaṃ tattha patiṭṭhapeyya tattha patiṭṭhapetvā yaṃ aduṃ khettaṃ majjhimaṃ tattha patiṭṭhapeyya tattha patiṭṭhapetvā yaṃ aduṃ khettaṃ hīnaṃ jaṅgalaṃ osaraṃ pāpabhūmi tattha patiṭṭhapeyyapi nopi patiṭṭhapeyya.
sn42.7:2.1: seyyathāpi gāmaṇi yaṃ aduṃ khettaṃ aggaṃ evameva mayhaṃ bhikkhu bhikkhuniyo
sn42.7:2.2: tesāhaṃ dhammaṃ desemi ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhekalyāṇaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ sabyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāsemi.
sn42.7:2.4: ete hi gāmaṇi maṃdīpā maṃleṇā maṃtāṇā maṃsaraṇā viharanti.
sn42.7:2.5: seyyathāpi gāmaṇi yaṃ aduṃ khettaṃ majjhimaṃ evameva mayhaṃ upāsakā upāsikāyo
sn42.7:2.6: tesāhaṃ dhammaṃ desemi ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhekalyāṇaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ sabyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāsemi.
sn42.7:2.8: ete hi gāmaṇi maṃdīpā maṃleṇā maṃtāṇā maṃsaraṇā viharanti.
sn42.7:2.9: seyyathāpi gāmaṇi yaṃ aduṃ khettaṃ hīnaṃ jaṅgalaṃ osaraṃ pāpabhūmi evameva mayhaṃ aññatitthiyā samaṇabrāhmaṇaparibbājakā
sn42.7:2.10: nesaṃ cāhaṃ dhammaṃ desemi ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhekalyāṇaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ sabyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāsemi.
sn42.7:2.12: appevanāma ekapadampi ājāneyyuṃ taṃ nesaṃ assa dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya.
sn42.7:3.1: seyyathāpi gāmaṇi purisassa tayo udakamaṇikā eko udakamaṇiko acchiddo ahāriaparihārī eko udakamaṇiko acchiddo hāriparihārī eko udakamaṇiko chiddo hāriparihārī.
sn42.7:3.2: taṃ kiṃ maññasi gāmaṇi asu puriso udakaṃ nikkhipitukāmo tattha paṭhamaṃ nikkhipeyya yo vā so udakamaṇiko acchiddo ahāriaparihārī yo vā so udakamaṇiko acchiddo hāriparihārī yo vā so udakamaṇiko chiddo hāriparihārī.
sn42.7:3.3: asu bhante puriso udakaṃ nikkhipitukāmo yo so udakamaṇiko acchiddo ahāriaparihārī tattha nikkhipeyya tattha nikkhipitvā yo so udakamaṇiko acchiddo hāriparihārī tattha nikkhipeyya tattha nikkhipitvā yo so udakamaṇiko chiddo hāriparihārī tattha nikkhipeyyapi nopi nikkhipeyya.
sn42.7:4.1: seyyathāpi gāmaṇi yo so udakamaṇiko acchiddo ahāriaparihārī evameva mayhaṃ bhikkhu bhikkhuniyo
sn42.7:4.2: tesāhaṃ dhammaṃ desemi ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhekalyāṇaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ sāttha sabyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāsemi.
sn42.7:4.4: ete hi gāmaṇi maṃdīpā maṃleṇā maṃtāṇā maṃsaraṇā viharanti.
sn42.7:4.5: seyyathāpi gāmaṇi yo so udakamaṇiko acchiddo hāriparihārī evameva mayhaṃ upāsakā upāsikāyo tesaṃ
sn42.7:4.6: ahaṃ dhammaṃ desemi ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhekalyāṇaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ sabyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāsemi.
sn42.7:4.8: ete hi gāmaṇi maṃdīpā maṃleṇā maṃtāṇā maṃsaraṇā viharanti.
sn42.7:4.9: seyyathāpi gāmaṇi yo so udakamaṇiko chiddo hāriparihārī evameva mayhaṃ aññatitthiyā samaṇabrāhmaṇaparibbājakā
sn42.7:4.10: tesaṃ ahaṃ dhammaṃ desemi ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhekalyāṇaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ sabyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāsemi.
sn42.7:4.12: appevanāma ekapadampi ājāneyyuṃ taṃ nesaṃ assa dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāyāti.
sn42.7:5.1: evaṃ vutte asibandhakaputto gāmaṇī bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn42.7:5.3: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhagavā dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṅgatanti.
